### Headline summary
- Critical vulnerabilities in OpenSSH, WordPress, and Microsoft Paint are being actively exploited in the wild. ([CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4245407/openssh-flaw-lets-attackers-access-password-disabled-accounts-on-some-linux-systems.html), [SOC Prime Blog](https://socprime.com/blog/cve-2026-123158-openssh-password-authentication-bypass-affects-alpine-linux/), [HackRead](https://hackread.com/cisa-hackers-exploiting-wordpress-core-vulnerability/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/240000-wordpress-exploit-attempts/))
- Major data breaches have exposed customer credentials at Chainalysis and DigiCert, while Gnosis Pay disclosed a leak of personal data. ([Cointelegraph.com News](https://cointelegraph.com/news/chainalysis-cyberattack-password-hashes-live-tokens-exposed?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/chainalysis-breach-exposes-all-users.html), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/digicert-data-breach-impacts-business-customer-information/), [The Record](https://therecord.media/digicert-certificate-authority-reports-data-breach))
- US agencies issued warnings regarding cyberattacks on refrigeration systems and AI-powered CEO impersonation scams. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/fbi-cisa-warn-of-cyberattacks-targeting-refrigeration-systems/), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/06/cyberattacks-refrigeration-systems-cisa-fbi/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/3-charged-in-scheme-to-use-ai-to-impersonate-ceos-and-attorneys-to-steal-129-million/), [The Record](https://therecord.media/ceo-spoofing-scammers-charged))

### OpenSSH SSHole Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild
A critical OpenSSH flaw allowing unauthorized access to password-disabled accounts on Linux systems was disclosed and quickly exploited by attackers. ([CSO Online](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4245407/openssh-flaw-lets-attackers-access-password-disabled-accounts-on-some-linux-systems.html), [SOC Prime Blog](https://socprime.com/blog/cve-2026-123158-openssh-password-authentication-bypass-affects-alpine-linux/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/openssh-rushes-patches-for-sshole-authentication-bypass/), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/06/openssh-sshole-cve-2026-123158-exploitation/))

### Hackers Exploit WordPress Core Vulnerability
Attackers launched over 240,000 exploit attempts against a critical WordPress Core vulnerability that enables remote code execution during updates. ([HackRead](https://hackread.com/cisa-hackers-exploiting-wordpress-core-vulnerability/), [Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/240000-wordpress-exploit-attempts/))

### Microsoft Paint Zero-Click RCE Vulnerability
A critical remote code execution flaw in Windows Paint, CVE-2026-83844, allows unauthenticated attackers to take control of PCs, with a fix now available. ([Cyber Security News (FeedBurner)](https://cybersecuritynews.com/windows-paint-rce-vulnerability/), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/microsoft-paint-rce-fix-now-available.html))

### Chainalysis Data Breach Exposes User Credentials
Chainalysis suffered a data breach that exposed customer credentials, forcing the company to shut down key services. ([Cointelegraph.com News](https://cointelegraph.com/news/chainalysis-cyberattack-password-hashes-live-tokens-exposed?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/chainalysis-breach-exposes-all-users.html), [BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/chainalysis-says-breach-exposed-credentials-for-all-customers/))

### DigiCert Reports Data Breach of Business Customers
Certificate authority DigiCert reported a data breach where hackers accessed an internal system to obtain business customer information. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/digicert-data-breach-impacts-business-customer-information/), [The Record](https://therecord.media/digicert-certificate-authority-reports-data-breach))

### US Agencies Warn of Cyberattacks on Refrigeration Systems
The FBI and CISA issued warnings regarding attacks targeting refrigeration systems. ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/fbi-cisa-warn-of-cyberattacks-targeting-refrigeration-systems/), [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/06/cyberattacks-refrigeration-systems-cisa-fbi/), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/202528/security/enisa-warns-of-cyberattacks-targeting-refrigeration-systems-across-europe.html), [Infosecurity Magazine](https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/news/cisa-protect-refrigeration-networks/))

### Gnosis Pay Data Breach Exposes Customer Information
Crypto card provider Gnosis Pay disclosed a data breach that exposed customer personal data and wallet information, though funds remained safe. ([Privacy Affairs](https://www.privacyaffairs.com/gnosis-pay-data-breach/), [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/382718/crypto-card-provider-gnosis-pay-hackers-customer-data), [Cointelegraph.com News](https://cointelegraph.com/news/gnosis-pay-breach-exposes-card-details-personal-data-crypto-wallet-information?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound))

### AI-Powered CEO Impersonation Scams
Three men were charged in the US for using AI to impersonate CEOs and attorneys to steal over $100 million in fraudulent payments. ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/3-charged-in-scheme-to-use-ai-to-impersonate-ceos-and-attorneys-to-steal-129-million/), [The Record](https://therecord.media/ceo-spoofing-scammers-charged), [The Guardian Cybercrime](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/06/ai-ceo-impersonation-theft))
